summary: Man fishing from his canoe on Marshall Lake capsized; found ~500 yards offshore clinging to the overturned canoe, waving for help. Rocky Mountain Fire performed a water rescue; paramedics found no injuries.
location: Marshall Lake, 6600 block of Marshall Road
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Fire Rescue; Boulder Emergency Squad
